summary.text: Ed Oliver, a Republican, has represented Alabama House District 81 since November 7, 2018, and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for re-election.

paragraphs.text: He graduated from Dadeville High School, earned a B.A. from the University of Alabama and graduated from the Command and General Staff College.
He served as an Army helicopter pilot, an inspector general and an air ambulance pilot for 15 years.
